notice: Non-authoritative offline diagnostic over synthetic mapping records. It reports metadata gaps, ambiguities, mismatches and invalid economics only. It performs no price conversion, roll choice, source-to-contract selection, sizing, order construction or authorization. INFO findings are not trading permission; the deterministic gateway is unchanged and still decides every action.
